race.title: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: STERLING COOPER improved markedly when third at Newmarket in September, shaping as if this step up to 1m will suit, and another step forward should see him off the mark. Lady Margo ran too green when fourth on debut over C&D last month but should be sharper for the experience, while Gilder Roy can prove a threat if coping with the drop back in trip. STERLING COOPER (IRE) LADY MARGO (IRE) GILDER ROY
